lauren: Drafting a one-page "goal snapshot" + 24h peer pulse so folks can share OKRs in <3 mins. Feedback?

lauren: SNAPSHOT (copy/paste):
```
Team: [team]
Quarter: Q3 2026
Owner: [name]
North Star (1 line): [output-focused]
Why it matters: [customer or biz impact]
Top 3 KRs (metric + target) + confidence (0-10):
 - KR1: [metric target] (conf 8)
 - KR2: [metric target] (conf 6)
 - KR3: [metric target] (conf 5)
Top 3 actions (est effort S/M/L):
 - Act 1 (M)
 - Act 2 (L)
 - Act 3 (S)
Key dependency/blocker: [person/system]
Primary signal to watch: [metric]
One-line ask to manager: [unblock/prioritize/hire]
Peer pulse (DM 3 peers, 3 one-line prompts):
 - Biggest customer impact?
 - What to deprioritize?
 - Anything missing or unclear?
Self-review note (for cycle):
 - For each KR: 1 line "what worked" + 1 line "evidence/metric"
 - End: 1-line lesson + 1 clear ask
```

diego: Nice and short. Add a single-word risk tag per KR (infra/data/headcount) so managers see failure modes.

amanda: Include 3 micro-reply samples so peers know how to respond quickly (one-liners).

lauren: Micro-replies (examples):
 - "Prioritize KR1; drop Act3"
 - "Clarify how KR2 ties to revenue"
 - "Targets look high; suggest -15% or add hire"

ops-bot: Goal snapshot template uploaded -> https://redwoodhq.internal/goals/snapshot. Auto-DM template scheduled. :robot_face:

lauren: Rollout checklist: add three role examples (SWE, PM, ML infra), wire to handbook, create DM button for peer pulse, send 5-min demo to managers.

diego: For manager 60s prompts: "What would success look like in 90 days?" "What's the riskiest assumption?" "One thing I can do this week?"

amanda: Suggest we auto-fill confidence=6 as default to nudge calibration.

lauren: I'll post filled examples tonight and open a short thread for manager comments tomorrow morning. thanks! :tada:
